title: JRB-1
owner: Jared Bland personally, per direct user instruction
source_audio_origin: Original M4A downloaded through Suno's signed-in Download dialog on 2026-10-19; Opus audio in an MP4 container, retained byte-for-byte.
conversion: Homebrew FFmpeg pcm_s16le decode, retaining exactly 9196800 frames from the original MP4 presentation. Apply a 480-frame (10 ms) half-cosine fade at each end: gain(i)=0.5-0.5*cos(pi*i/479), mirrored at the end, PCM16 rounded to nearest. Interior PCM remains unchanged; no normalization or extra lossy encoding.
runtime_choice: Native WAV avoids an unavailable libvorbis encoder and an extra lossy encode/dependency. One bounded stereo track; known runtime/memory cost recorded.
rights_scope: LICENSE; qualified original-project personal ownership, third-party rights unchanged.
presentation_timing: MP4 stts: 9580 packets × 960 plus 312 samples; elst skips 312 pre-roll samples. Presentation: 9,196,800 stereo frames at 48 kHz.
